description: NaLi₂FeCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.85 Å. There are four inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.15 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 70-85°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.37 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.56 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.42 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-63°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form corner-sharing OLi₂FeP tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share corners with six OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with five OLi₂FeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂C tetrahedra.
